device_entry.name: QuTech中央控制器
device_entry.description: 用于量子计算实验的中央控制电子设备，通常基于FPGA执行时序与序列程序，协调CCIO模块、数字I/O链路和时序延迟设置，为量子比特控制与读出实验提供同步控制。
device_entry.description_en: A central control electronics unit for quantum computing experiments, typically FPGA-based, used to execute timing and sequence programs, coordinate CCIO modules, digital I/O links, and timing delay settings, and provide synchronized control for qubit control and readout experiments.

tags.name: 实验执行&合成设备
tags.rationale: This controller executes timing/sequence programs and synchronizes experimental control and readout, so it belongs to experiment execution.

tags.name: 智慧表征与检测中心
tags.rationale: No quantum-control-specific domain exists; this is the closest generic domain for advanced instrument control, testing, and synchronized experimental platforms.

tags.name: 物化表征测试中心
tags.rationale: No quantum-computing scene is available; this is the nearest generic experimental testing scene for complex instrument-control setups.

tags.name: 实验时序控制器
tags.rationale: No existing template fits an FPGA-based central sequencer/controller. This proposed tag covers broad laboratory timing/control units that coordinate triggers, digital I/O, synchronized sequences, and subsystem timing across complex experiments.

proposed_new_tags.name: 实验时序控制器
proposed_new_tags.rationale: Broad template for FPGA/sequencer-based central controllers used to orchestrate timing, triggers, digital I/O, and synchronized experiment programs in quantum, photonics, and other automated research systems.
